content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Sugar Land

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour and year thresholds for your background—whether you hold a bachelor's degree, associate degree, or high school diploma. Verify your project experience qualifies before you apply.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Attend synchronous sessions taught by active certified practitioners. You'll cover the PMBOK Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world scenarios—all online, on a schedule that fits your Sugar Land–area work commitments.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing Granite PM Academy's course, submit your formal PMP application directly to PMI. You'll provide education and experience documentation and pay PMI's exam fee. Allow time for PMI to review and approve your application before scheduling your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor Q&A support—to solidify your knowledge. Once approved by PMI, schedule your computer-based exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. The exam assesses your mastery across the full PMP knowledge domains.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to the standard three-year renewal cycle. Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through approved training, conferences, volunteering, and on-the-job project work. Renew your credential before expiration to keep it active and recognized in your local job market.
